newsitem.title: USA: Cost Plus January same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Cost Plus January same-store sales rise.

text.p: Cost Plus Inc said its same-store sales for the four-week period ended February 1, 1997 rose 2.3 percent from the four-week period ended February 3, 1996.
For the fourth quarter ended February 1, 1997, same-store sales rose 7.3 percent over the same 13-week period last year.
Year-to-date, same-store sales for the 52-week period ended February 1, 1997 rose 6.1 percent over the 52-week period ended February 3, 1996.
Total sales for the four-week period ended February 1, 1997 were $12.6 million, a 15.6 percent rose from $10.9 million, for the four-week period ended February 3, 1996.
For the fourth quarter, total sales for the 13-week period ended February 1, 1997 were $90.7 million, a 21.1 percent increase from $74.9 million for the same 13-week period last year.
Year-to-date, total sales for the 52-week period ended February 1, 1997 were $214.8 million, a 20.3 percent increase from $178.6 million, for the 52-week period ended February 3, 1996.
As of February 1, 1997 the Company operated 58 stores compared to 49 stores as of February 3, 1996.
